info.title: Vault API
info.description: Document storage, workspaces and revocable share links. JSON over HTTPS with a session cookie. Every error has the shape { error: { code, message } }. The same routes are served under /api/v1.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the stored bytes; null only while an older file is backfilled.

links.description: Rollup of live share links. Present in listings.

folderId.description: null moves the document to the workspace root.

distinctViewers.description: Estimate: NAT merges viewers, network changes split them.

expiresInHours.description: null = never expires; omitted = the default (create) or unchanged (edit).
